label: ALL RESULTS ARE BACKTEST ESTIMATES, not predictions or real trading results.

rules.funding: actual OKX history where available, else ESTIMATED from the coin's median rate
rules.walk_forward: 5 segments, expanding train, best variant by train R
kill: OOS return after costs <= equal-weight buy-and-hold over the same OOS windows
rules.risk: 1% of equity per trade, notional capped at 3x equity, max 3 concurrent

strategy_cards.name: Short memes that haven't dropped yet as BTC falls
strategy_cards.idea: When BTC falls in a bear regime, memes usually follow down harder with a delay.
strategy_cards.why_edge_exists_who_loses: Holders who react to BTC with a delay and buy/sell after the move.
strategy_cards.entry: On a closed 4h bar where the alt_lag_btc rule fires ({"dir": -1, "win_h": 24, "btc_pct": 3, "lag_pct": 0.5}) and the coin's regime is one of ['ranging', 'trending']: enter at next bar open (paper bot: marketable limit at live price +/-0.05%).
strategy_cards.exit: Take profit at 2.0R, or time exit after 48h.
strategy_cards.stop: 1.5 x ATR(14) from entry, attached at entry (same-bar stop+target counts as a stop).
strategy_cards.size: Risk 1% of equity per trade: notional = 1% x equity / stop distance, capped at 3x equity; max 3 open positions.

results_after_costs_ESTIMATE.costs: fee 0.1%/side, slippage 0.05%/side, funding at each settlement

strategy_cards.condition_that_kills_it: Stop trading it if rolling 50-trade avg R falls below 0, or paper drawdown exceeds -13% (1.5x the OOS max drawdown).
strategy_cards.first_sign_its_weakening: Recent 90-day avg R (1.305) dropping below half the full-sample avg R (0.255), or 5+ losses in a row.
WHY_THIS_COULD_FAIL: 95% of backtest trades use ESTIMATED funding (OKX only serves ~3 months of funding history).
17 of 21 markets have less than 4 years of history; most memes listed in 2023-2025, so results lean on one cycle.
Survivorship bias: the universe is today's listed memes; coins that died are not in the test.
Loses money (avg R <= 0) when BTC is bull.
Paper fills assume next-bar open plus 0.05% slippage; real meme order books can be thinner during flushes.
